capabilities.assertionScope: Existing Django with real Python SDK AppSec/IAST/RASP and typed API Security schemas. Exact named cases require real native reports, correlated source/sink addresses, independent safe controls or enabled/disabled schemas and genuine SDK telemetry. Structured security-report assertions use supported v0.4; v0.5 omissions remain gaps. Local WAF rules/exclusions/block actions do not claim remote configuration. Pickle naming and redirect/user-block-ID SDK discrepancies remain explicitly scoped.
